concepts.def: James Hargreaves' multi-spindle frame multiplying cotton thread output; transformed domestic textile industry.
James Watt's 1769 separate condenser improved Newcomen design; powered mines, factories and after 1804 railways.
Stephenson's locomotive winning Rainhill Trials at 30mph; established standard for Liverpool-Manchester Railway.
Series limiting child labour and hours: 1833 banned under 9s in textiles; 1847 Ten Hours Act for women and children.
Grey's Great Reform Act extended franchise to £10 householders, abolished rotten boroughs, redistributed seats to industrial cities.
Protectionist tariffs 1815-46 keeping grain prices high; repealed by Peel after Anti-Corn Law League agitation and Irish famine.
